opportunities.title: Regular Grants (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant – under £100,000. Grants tend to be approximately 10–20% of an organisation's total costs; local community capital projects up to a maximum of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidelines. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Must work in the UK or UK Overseas Territories. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme for charities under £100,000, covering operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open all year round with no submission deadlines. Applications reviewed in order received, decisions within 4–6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grants (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: Major Grant – £100,000 and over. Total cost of what you are applying for must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For capital/project costs: total project cost must be at least £1 million regardless of organisation's annual income. For core costs: organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. Must be eligible UK registered charities, CIOs, or exempt/excepted organisations.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme for grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via an Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no submission deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis.
